subject: Car of the Year --> Steel Wheels ??
author: eswat2
body:
I'll have to look again next time i'm in the game, but i believe it's Steel Wheels on the poster for "Car of the Year".  That's the car that you got if you pre-ordered the game (unlocks via a code).  It doesn't unlock any other way...

** still working on my Elite License (after that it's on to the Criterion Elite License)

subject: Either Steel Wheels or rossalini
author: Mad Wookiee11
body: If it's the steel wheels, you can find the code for it online if you google product codes.  The other car I see on billboards is the Rossaline Tempesta which is the car you get for reaching A class liscense.

subject: Car Codes
author: ZombieTron
body:
All of the car codes are in our FAQ, the Steel Wheels car is available once you get the Burnout License and unlock the GT concept which is the car it is based on.
